entities.summary: Yuliyan Mikhaylov Strogov is a boxer from Bulgaria. He was born in Dobrich. At the 1992 Summer Olympics he was stopped in the second round of the Men's Flyweight (51 kg) division by eventual bronze medalist Timothy Austin of the United States. At the 1996 Summer Olympics in the Men's Flyweight division, he was stopped in the first round by Ireland's Damaen Kelly. Strogov had won a silver medal in the same division earlier the same year, at the 1996 European Amateur Boxing Championships in Vejle. Yuliyan Strogov was a athletes & competitors from Dobrich (b. 1972-04-28, Dobrich). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Yuliyan Strogov's Olympic performances in the Men's Flyweight division influenced his career trajectory and contributed to Bulgaria's amateur boxing development. His silver medal at the 1996 European Amateur Boxing Championships had a lasting impact on Bulgarian sports.
